# Global Crimson Education Hub

> Independent study-abroad counselling agency based in Biratchowk, Morang, Nepal. Helps Nepali students choose universities, prepare applications, win scholarships, and secure visas for Australia, the United Kingdom, Canada, the United States, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea, Finland, Sweden, and Denmark. Also runs IELTS, PTE, Duolingo, Japanese language, and computer classes.

Global Crimson Education Hub is a full-service education consultancy. A single counsellor manages each student's file end to end: free consultation, university shortlisting and application, offer comparison and scholarship/loan support, visa file preparation with mock interviews, and pre-departure orientation.

## Services
- [Study destinations](https://www.globalcrimson.com/#destinations): Australia, UK, Canada, USA, New Zealand, Japan, Finland, South Korea, Sweden, Denmark
- [Application process](https://www.globalcrimsoneducation.com/#process): 5-stage counselling process from consultation to pre-departure
- [Test prep & language classes](https://www.globalcrimson.com/#classes): IELTS, PTE, Duolingo English Test, Japanese language, computer classes
- [Student testimonials](https://www.globalcrimsoneducation.com/#stories)
